invention.en: Paper is one of the most important inventions in history.
invention.cn: 纸是历史上最重要的发明之一。

invent.en: Edison invented the light bulb over a hundred years ago.
invent.cn: 爱迪生一百多年前发明了灯泡。

phone.en: A phone keeps me connected with friends and family.
phone.cn: 手机让我和亲友保持联系。

computer.en: Computers help us learn, work and play.
computer.cn: 电脑帮我们学习、工作和娱乐。

internet.en: The internet brings the whole world to our screens.
internet.cn: 互联网把世界带到我们屏幕上。

robot.en: Some robots can help doctors do small surgeries.
robot.cn: 有的机器人能帮医生做小手术。

change.en: New inventions change the way we live and work.
change.cn: 新发明改变我们生活和工作的方式。

future.en: In the future, cars may drive themselves to school.
future.cn: 未来汽车也许会自己开去学校。
